summary: Yarrow Bioscience, Inc. (Nasdaq: YARW) filed a routine Form 8-K on September 10, 2026, furnishing an investor presentation and updating Part I, Item 1 of its FY2025 Form 10-K to reflect a completed merger with Yarrow Bioscience Operating Company Corp. No new transaction, price, stake, or board recommendation is disclosed; the filing merely conforms historical disclosure and confirms no impact on previously reported results, financial position, or cash flows. No special-situation catalyst, deal terms, advisor, or regulatory clock is present. Watch for future 10-Q/8-K disclosures for substantive developments, not this administrative update.
